how.title: How does it work?
how.body: IndieHost empowers independent hosts to run their vacation rentals their way. We built it to free you from OTA commissions—so you keep more revenue and control your guest relationships.

slides.title: Edit and customize your listings
slides.description:
Once your listing is created, customize it freely with a simple visual editor. Preview every change in real time and edit content in one click: select an element in the preview and jump straight to the right field.

A created but unpublished listing stays as a draft, so your changes remain saved.

slides.title: Performance and invoices in one place
slides.description: Track revenue, occupancy, and guest loyalty at a glance. Export detailed monthly stats and access all your invoices in one click. Streamline your admin.

slides.title: Synchronized bookings in an intuitive dashboard
slides.description:
Add your Airbnb or Booking calendar links—dates blocked elsewhere automatically block here too. Eliminate double bookings.

View reservation history by property, guest details, and payment status. Manage everything from one place.

slides.title: Flexible, secure payments
slides.description: Don't lose guests over payment options. Accept full payment online, deposit + balance, or cash—whatever suits your business. Stripe-powered security means guests book with confidence.

slides.title: Communicate simply
slides.description: Message guests securely through IndieHost—instant, organized, all in one inbox. Visitors who scan your welcome guide can reach you without creating an account. Reconnect with guests, even if they booked via Airbnb or Booking.

strengths.title: Built on transparency, respect, trust

children.question: What is IndieHost?
children.answer: IndieHost is an all-in-one vacation rental platform that gives power back to hosts. We free you from OTA commissions by providing everything you need: your own website, booking engine, payments, and calendar—all under your control, with zero commission on your revenue.

children.question: How is IndieHost different from Airbnb or Booking.com?
children.answer: Unlike OTAs, IndieHost takes zero commission on your bookings. You own the guest relationship, your brand, and your pricing. Customize your page, use your own domain, and stay commission-free—something traditional platforms don't allow.

children.question: If you don't take commissions, how do you make money?
children.answer: Our model is simple and transparent: a monthly subscription with no commitment, and zero commission on your bookings. IndieHost costs €19/month incl. VAT for 2 listings online, SuperHost €49/month for 6 listings. Beyond that, each extra listing is billed €12/month.

children.question: What type of host is IndieHost for?
children.answer:
Every host who wants to take back control of their bookings:

IndieHost (€19/month): individuals and hosts managing 1 or 2 properties.

SuperHost (€49/month): multi-property hosts, up to 6 listings.

On both plans, each extra listing is €12/month.

children.question: What does direct booking mean?
children.answer: Direct booking means the guest books directly with you, the owner, with no intermediary. IndieHost provides the technology so you can accept these bookings on your own page. The benefit is twofold: you pay no commission and you control the entire customer relationship (data, communication, loyalty).

children.question: Is there a free trial? Any hidden fees?
children.answer: Every plan starts with a 30-day free trial, no commitment. After that, €19 or €49 per month incl. VAT, and that’s it: no commission on your bookings and no hidden fees from us. Only Stripe’s transaction fees apply to card payments, as with any online payment.

children.question: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
children.answer: Yes. Our subscriptions have no commitment and can be cancelled at any time, free of charge, from your account (My profile, My subscription). Your subscription stays active until the end of the period you already paid for, with no further charge.

children.question: What if I have more properties than my plan allows?
children.answer: You add extra listings in one click from your dashboard: €12/month incl. VAT per listing, prorated and removable at any time. From 5 properties, switching to SuperHost becomes the better deal.

children.question: What happens if I have multiple properties in different locations?
children.answer: Our rule is that listings on the same account must belong to the same person (individual or legal entity). If you manage properties for different owners, each owner will need to create their own IndieHost account.

children.question: How am I paid by guests?
children.answer: We use Stripe Connect, the global reference for secure online payment. When you sign up, you connect your bank account to Stripe. When a guest pays, the money is processed by Stripe and transferred directly to your account. IndieHost never acts as a financial intermediary and never holds your money.

children.question: Does IndieHost take a commission on payments?
children.answer: No, never. You receive 100% of the amount paid by the guest (minus Stripe's standard transaction fees, which are unavoidable for any card payment).

children.question: Can I request a deposit instead of full payment?
children.answer: Yes. You set your own payment rules: full payment at booking, or a deposit with the balance paid before or on arrival. Deposits are included in every plan.

children.question: Is payment secure for my clients?
children.answer: Absolutely. Stripe Connect handles billions of transactions and meets the strictest security standards (PCI DSS). Guests can pay with confidence, knowing their banking information is encrypted and protected.

children.question: When do I receive the money from the booking?
children.answer: To secure the transaction for both host and guest, the payment is securely held by our partner Stripe after booking confirmation. The amount is then transferred to your account once the guest has validated their check-in. This escrow system ensures the property is compliant and the guest has arrived, building mutual trust. Once released, the payment appears in your Stripe account and is then transferred to your bank account according to Stripe's usual schedule (generally within a few days).

children.question: How do I create my listing on IndieHost?
children.answer: With our live editor. On the left, you fill in your information (title, photos, amenities); on the right, you instantly see the final result. In a few minutes, your page is ready to share.

children.question: How many listings can I create?
children.answer: IndieHost allows 2 listings online and SuperHost 6. Drafts are unlimited: a listing only counts once it is online. Each extra listing costs €12/month incl. VAT, on either plan.

children.question: What information is required at registration?
children.answer: When you sign up, we'll ask for basic administrative information. This is necessary to ensure the platform's legal compliance, including payment management via Stripe and, if you're an individual, for future tourism tax redistribution.

children.question: Is the tool complicated to use for someone who isn't very technical?
children.answer: No, the tool is designed to be intuitive. The live editor guides you step by step. Plus, your dashboard centralizes all key information (earnings, guests) clearly and visually. For even simpler daily management, a mobile app is available, allowing you to manage your listings and bookings directly from your phone.

children.question: How does iCal calendar synchronization work?
children.answer: Synchronization is bidirectional. You give IndieHost your iCal links (Airbnb, Booking, etc.) to import your external reservations, and IndieHost provides you with an iCal link to copy into your other platforms. As soon as a booking is made on one platform, it blocks the dates on all others, avoiding double bookings.

children.question: Can I manually add a booking made by phone?
children.answer: Yes, it is included in the SuperHost plan. You add or edit a booking manually (a regular guest booking by phone, for instance) to block the dates in your IndieHost calendar.

children.question: How does the calendar display my bookings?
children.answer: Your IndieHost calendar centralizes everything. It displays your bookings with a clear view of their source (IndieHost, Airbnb, Booking, Manual…). You have multiple views (monthly, weekly) for easier management.

children.question: How am I notified of a new booking?
children.answer: You receive real-time notifications via the app, SMS, or email for any new booking request or payment confirmation, letting you respond quickly to your guests.

children.question: Can I automate communication with my guests (SMS, notifications)?
children.answer: Yes. The SuperHost plan includes automated messaging: schedule SMS and notifications at key moments (confirmation, the day before arrival, departure) to save time and professionalise your welcome.

children.question: If I'm not on Airbnb, how will guests find me?
children.answer: IndieHost gives you the tools for direct acquisition. You can share your IndieHost page link on social media, Google Maps, etc. Plus, we offer a powerful paid option: Google Travel (Google Hotels) integration.

children.question: What is Google Travel integration?
children.answer: It is a paid option, available on any plan, that lists your property directly in Google Travel / Google Hotels results: a powerful direct-acquisition channel with no middleman.

children.question: What's the benefit of being on Google Travel with IndieHost?
children.answer: The argument is simple: since you pay no commission on IndieHost, you can display on Google Travel a price 15% to 20% lower than your listings on Booking or Airbnb. You become the most competitive offer and capture direct bookings.

children.question: Does IndieHost have a search engine for guests?
children.answer: Yes. In addition to your individual listing page, IndieHost has a search engine (by location, date, number of guests) that lets travelers visiting our site discover your property.

children.question: Do you help retain clients and build a direct relationship?
children.answer:
Yes, it's a pillar of the IndieHost offering. Retention starts from the first stay with the digital welcome booklet.

Direct Communication Channel: Via a QR code placed in the property, the guest accesses a complete digital guide. This guide includes a dedicated instant messaging system, giving you a direct, professional communication channel with your guest (for all stay information) that belongs to you, unlike OTA messaging.

Premium Experience: This booklet centralizes all the information needed for a smooth stay (guides, contacts, etc.). It improves the guest experience, which encourages good reviews (helping your future acquisition) and direct bookings (loyalty).

Re-marketing Tools: With the SuperHost plan, you also have email campaign tools to recontact your past clients with special offers and encourage them to book with you again.

children.question: Can I use my own domain name (e.g., www.my-guesthouse.com)?
children.answer: Absolutely. You attach a domain name you already own (e.g. www.my-cottage.com) to your listing from the Domains page: DNS setup is guided step by step and the HTTPS certificate is automatic. It is included in both plans; every listing also gets a free IndieHost subdomain.

children.question: What happens if I don't have a domain name?
children.answer: No problem. If you don't have a custom domain name, you get a standard IndieHost URL (for example indiehost.com/your-property) that you can share immediately.

children.question: What is the 'theme bank'?
children.answer: It's graphic themes for your booking page. Instead of having the same look as everyone else, you can choose a theme (design, colors, typography) that matches the atmosphere of your property (modern, rustic, luxury...).

children.question: How much can I customize my listing?
children.answer: You have advanced control. Between the live editor (for content: photos, text, amenities, rules) and theme choice (for design), you can create a unique, professional booking page that truly reflects your brand.

children.question: What is KYC verification?
children.answer: KYC (Know Your Customer) is an identity verification process essential to prevent fraud and reassure guests. We verify your identity (which must match the account name), proof of property ownership, and your municipal rental registration number.

children.question: Is KYC verification mandatory?
children.answer: It is included and recommended in the SuperHost plan, and offered as an option on IndieHost. Passing KYC gives your listing a “Verified” badge, a trust signal for travellers.

children.question: How does IndieHost handle tourism tax?
children.answer: For individual hosts, our system is designed to manage automatic redistribution of tourism tax to the relevant authorities. This frees you from a complex administrative burden.

children.question: Is guest verification possible?
children.answer: Yes, we plan to offer an option to verify guest identity. This is particularly useful if you, as a host, issue rental agreements and need to certify your tenant's identity.

nodes.title: Technical integrations with PMS and RMS

children.question: Is IndieHost compatible with my Channel Manager (PMS) or RMS (Revenue Management System)?
children.answer: Yes. Integration with third-party management tools (PMS such as SuperHote, or dynamic-pricing RMS) is included in the SuperHost plan: your listings, prices, availability and bookings sync from your central system.
